title: A diary for many years
description: A personal archive with search, backups and a readable export. When the phone changes, the dates, the photos and the history of entries survive.

blocks.text: A personal diary builds up over years. What matters to the person is the dates, the photos and being able to return to the entries even if they change the phone or the service itself.

quote.text: TEN YEARS I’ve been using this app now; I just checked. (Strangely, to the month! So call this my ‘decade anniversary’ review.)

blocks.text: Keep the history searchable, show how fresh the copy is and let the texts and attachments be exported in a readable form. The migration ends with checking an old entry on the new device.

The terms of access to your own archive after the subscription ends are needed in advance. The export has to preserve the sense of the material, not just the number of files. This is the basis of long use, but a promise of “forever” on its own is not enough to choose a product by.
